tagline: Idols, fandoms, comeback stages and Hong Kong's own pop legends.
why: K-pop is a global cultural force, and Canto-pop is the soundtrack of Hong Kong. Fans follow groups closely, buy albums, attend concerts and debate who's best. In Hong Kong, Canto-pop has had a revival led by boy band MIRROR, while legends like Leslie Cheung and Anita Mui still define the city's culture. Knowing the key names and fan language makes music small talk easy.

essentials.title: How K-pop works
essentials.body: Entertainment companies train young 'idols' for years, then debut them in groups with polished choreography. Groups release music in 'comebacks'.

essentials.title: The big agencies
essentials.body: HYBE (BTS, SEVENTEEN), SM (aespa, NCT), JYP (TWICE, Stray Kids) and YG (BLACKPINK) dominate.

essentials.title: Fandoms are powerful
essentials.body: Each group's fandom has a name (BTS has ARMY, BLACKPINK has BLINK). Fans stream, vote and buy to support their idols.

essentials.title: Canto-pop's golden age
essentials.body: In the 1980s and 90s Hong Kong pop ruled Asia: Leslie Cheung, Anita Mui, Sam Hui and the Four Heavenly Kings.

essentials.title: The revival
essentials.body: Since 2018, MIRROR and its members like Keung To and Anson Lo brought young fans back to Canto-pop.

essentials.title: Concerts are events
essentials.body: Big shows at the Hong Kong Coliseum, AsiaWorld-Expo and the new Kai Tak Stadium sell out in minutes.

names.name: BTS
names.what: The biggest K-pop group ever; reunited after military service in 2025.

names.name: BLACKPINK
names.what: The biggest girl group; Lisa, Jennie, Rosé and Jisoo all had solo hits. Rosé's 'APT.' with Bruno Mars was a 2024-25 megahit.

names.name: Stray Kids
names.what: JYP group that topped US charts repeatedly.

names.name: NewJeans
names.what: Hit girl group caught in a legal dispute with its agency ADOR.

names.name: MIRROR
names.what: 12-member Hong Kong boy band that revived Canto-pop.

names.name: Keung To
names.what: MIRROR's most popular member and a solo star.

names.name: Leslie Cheung
names.what: Canto-pop and film legend who died in 2003; still adored.

names.name: Anita Mui
names.what: 'The Madonna of Asia', Hong Kong's pop queen who died in 2003.

names.name: Eason Chan
names.what: The most successful Canto-pop singer of the 2000s and beyond.

names.name: G.E.M.
names.what: Hong Kong singer-songwriter who became a mainland superstar.

names.name: Beyond
names.what: Legendary Hong Kong rock band; 'Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies' is an anthem.

now.headline: BIGBANG at Kai Tak
now.detail: BIGBANG's 20th-anniversary world tour plays Kai Tak Stadium this weekend, 13-15 November.

now.headline: BTS head back to Asia
now.detail: The ARIRANG tour's Asian leg starts 19 November in Kaohsiung, with 15 shows in five cities including Bangkok and Kuala Lumpur.

now.headline: ARIRANG album
now.detail: BTS's fifth full album, released in March, was their first as a full group since military service.

now.headline: Busy November releases
now.detail: TXT's PERFECT STORM (16 Nov), NAYEON and ENHYPEN (20 Nov) and TAEYEON's album Unspecial (30 Nov).

now.headline: Jennie's Netflix song
now.detail: BLACKPINK's Jennie released Someone to Hold for the Netflix film Steps on 6 November.

now.headline: Kai Tak concerts
now.detail: Hong Kong's new stadium has made the city a stop for the biggest K-pop and Canto-pop shows.

local.headline: MIRROR fever
local.detail: MIRROR's members are everywhere: ads, dramas and concerts.

local.headline: Canto-pop nostalgia
local.detail: Karaoke favourites by Eason Chan, Jacky Cheung and Leslie Cheung are KTV staples.

local.headline: KTV culture
local.detail: Karaoke at Neway or Red Mr is a classic night out with friends or colleagues.

local.headline: Kai Tak Stadium
local.detail: The 50,000-seat stadium opened in 2025 and hosts big K-pop and global tours.

debates.question: Is K-pop's system too harsh?
debates.sides: Polished results vs gruelling training and pressure on young idols.

debates.question: Can Canto-pop stay relevant?
debates.sides: MIRROR proved there's demand; the mainland market dominates.

debates.question: Who's the best K-pop group?
debates.sides: BTS for impact; BLACKPINK for global reach; fans of others disagree loudly.
